text: You came to help me in spite of the danger?\c\nThanks, Hop. And you, [VAR 0100(0000)].\nYou two really have grown tremendously![VAR 0114(0004)]

But no need for you kids to worry.\c
It seems like some power of Eternatus’s
was keeping my team from Dynamaxing, but...
we’ve had a champion time all the same![VAR 0114(0004)]
Charizard and the rest of my champion team\nmembers have really worn Eternatus down.[VAR 0114(0004)]

Now if I can simply catch it in a Poké Ball,
we should be able to get this madness
under control.
Then everything will be back to normal.\c
So watch this!
It’s going to be a real champion catch![VAR 0114(0004)]
